definitions.explanation: The amount of food placed on a dish or in a bowl. Also refers to the way food is arranged and presented on a plate.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}{盛|も}りにしてください。
examples.english: Please make it a large serving.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{盛|も}りがいい。
サラダの{盛|も}りが{美|うつく}しくて、{食|た}べるのがもったいないくらいだった。
examples.english: The salad was so beautifully arranged that it almost seemed a waste to eat it.

notes:
USAGE:
The nominal form of the verb {盛|も}る (to heap, to serve). Very commonly used in compound forms: {大|おお}{盛|も}り (large serving), {普通|ふつう}{盛|も}り (regular serving), {特|とく}{盛|も}り (extra-large serving). At restaurants, {盛|も}りがいい means the portions are generous. Also used for the visual presentation of food ({盛|も}り{付|つ}け = plating).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{盛|も}り: large serving
- {特|とく}{盛|も}り: extra-large serving
- {盛|も}りがいい: generous portions
- {盛|も}り{付|つ}け: food plating/arrangement
- {盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ: assorted platter
